metrics.late_report_rate_per_1000: analysis late_reports divided by profile scale_denominator times 1000
metrics.finding_rate_per_1000: analysis unresolved_findings divided by profile scale_denominator times 1000
metrics.compliance_attention_score: weighted normalized gap rate, gap-rate change, late-report rate, finding rate, and criticality

normalization: Min-max normalize each score component across included active programs before applying weights.
display_rounding: Round percentages, percentage-point changes, rates, and scores to one decimal.
